response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development, including C/C++ (via National Instruments and embedded systems work), but lacks direct experience with industrial automation, C++ STL, secure development lifecycle (SDL), or IEC 62443 standards. Their expertise is heavily skewed toward web, mobile, and scripting languages (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Python) rather than high-performance C++ systems, multi-threading, or industrial cybersecurity. While they demonstrate strong problem-solving and architectural skills, their relevance to the role is limited.
strengths: Strong background in C and C++ (National Instruments, embedded systems)
Experience with high-performance and low-latency systems (Dlang, Asynchronous I/O)
Proven track record in scalable architectures and DevOps (CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker)
concerns: Lacks direct experience with C++ STL, object-oriented C++ design, or industrial automation protocols
No demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards
Limited exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) or message-broker-based systems required for the role
